response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms), AVG(track_count) FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / Milliseconds) as avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) AS media_stats

assumptions.assumption: Milliseconds is always positive (greater than zero) to avoid division by zero.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute the average rate as (total Bytes) ÷ (total Milliseconds) per media type, rather than the average of per-track ratios. Both are valid measures of 'average bytes per millisecond'.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms), AVG(track_count) FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS FLOAT) / SUM(Milliseconds) as avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) AS media_stats
